pli-tv-bu-vb-pc72:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc72:1.2: tena kho pana samayena bhagavā bhikkhūnaṃ anekapariyāyena vinayakathaṃ katheti vinayassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati, vinayapariyattiyā vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati ādissa ādissa āyasmato upālissa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc72:1.4: “bhagavā kho anekapariyāyena vinayakathaṃ katheti vinayassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati vinayapariyattiyā vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati ādissa ādissa āyasmato upālissa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc72:1.5: handa mayaṃ āvuso āyasmato upālissa santike vinayaṃ pariyāpuṇāmā”ti te ca bahū bhikkhū therā ca navā ca majjhimā ca āyasmato upālissa santike vinayaṃ pariyāpuṇanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc72:1.7: “etarahi kho āvuso bahū bhikkhū therā ca navā ca majjhimā ca āyasmato upālissa santike vinayaṃ pariyāpuṇanti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc72:1.8: sace ime vinaye pakataññuno bhavissanti amhe yenicchakaṃ yadicchakaṃ yāvaticchakaṃ ākaḍḍhissanti parikaḍḍhissanti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc72:1.10: atha kho chabbaggiyā bhikkhū bhikkhū upasaṅkamitvā evaṃ vadenti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc72:1.11: “kiṃ panimehi khuddānukhuddakehi sikkhāpadehi uddiṭṭhehi yāvadeva kukkuccāya vihesāya vilekhāya saṃvattantī”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc72:1.12: ye te bhikkhū appicchā …pe… te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc72:1.13: “kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhū vinayaṃ vivaṇṇessantī”ti …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc72:1.14: saccaṃ kira tumhe bhikkhave, vinayaṃ vivaṇṇethāti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc72:1.17: kathaṃ hi nāma tumhe moghapurisā vinayaṃ vivaṇṇessatha.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc72:1.19: evañca pana bhikkhave, imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc72:1.20.1: “yo pana bhikkhu pātimokkhe uddissamāne evaṃ vadeyya kiṃ panimehi khuddānukhuddakehi sikkhāpadehi uddiṭṭhehi, yāvadeva kukkuccāya vihesāya vilekhāya saṃvattantīti sikkhāpadavivaṇṇake pācittiya”nti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc72:2.1.6: uddisante vā uddisāpente vā sajjhāyaṃ vā karonte.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc72:2.1.8: kiṃ panimehi khuddānukhuddakehi sikkhāpadehi uddiṭṭhehi yāvadeva kukkuccāya vihesāya vilekhāya saṃvattantīti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc72:2.1.9: ye imaṃ pariyāpuṇanti tesaṃ kukkuccaṃ hoti vihesā hoti vilekhā hoti. “ye imaṃ na pariyāpuṇanti tesaṃ kukkuccaṃ na hoti vihesā na hoti vilekhā na hoti. anuddiṭṭhaṃ idaṃ varaṃ anuggahitaṃ idaṃ varaṃ apariyāpuṇitaṃ idaṃ varaṃ, adhāritaṃ idaṃ varaṃ vinayo vā antaradhāyatu, ime vā bhikkhū apakataññuno hontū”ti upasampannassa vinayaṃ vivaṇṇeti āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc72:2.2.1: upasampanne upasampannasaññī vinayaṃ vivaṇṇeti āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc72:2.2.2: upasampanne vematiko vinayaṃ vivaṇṇeti āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc72:2.2.3: upasampanne anupasampannasaññī vinayaṃ vivaṇṇeti āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc72:2.2.5: anupasampannassa vinayaṃ vā aññaṃ vā dhammaṃ vivaṇṇeti āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc72:2.3.2: na vivaṇṇetukāmo iṅgha tāva suttante vā gāthāyo vā abhidhammaṃ vā pariyāpraṇassra, pacchāpi vinayaṃ pariyāpuṇissasīti bhaṇati
